- **Date & Time Doctor finds wrong dates (FL-912):** once a week, and whenever you ask, Frameleaf looks for photos whose date or time zone is probably wrong: dates in the future or on a camera's reset day, a date in the file name that doesn't match, a time zone that doesn't match where the photo was taken, a camera with no time zone, and a camera clock that was fast or slow next to your phone. It suggests a fix for each and changes nothing yet; the page to review and apply them comes next.
- **Dates from file names (FL-912):** a photo or screenshot with no date of its own now takes the date in its name, such as IMG_20230512_134501 or a WhatsApp file's day, instead of the day the file was copied.
- **Dates that can't be right stay out of the way (FL-1410, FL-1452, FL-1456):** photos dated in the future or on a camera's reset day no longer lead the Library, stretch an album's dates or decide what a trip or memory is. They wait in Dates to check, which pages through large groups and is linked from albums, tags and folders.
- **When and where instead of file names (FL-1392):** photos show when and where they were taken, with File details one click away.
- **Albums with real names (FL-1411):** album titles can run to two lines, trips are named by the place, and phone albums keep their names.
- **One kind of empty page (FL-1412):** every page that has nothing to show yet looks the same and says what to do.
- **Smaller fixes across the web (FL-1457):** the viewer's photo strip, Full screen on phones, search tabs, memory titles on Explore, album headers, empty pages, a stopped scan and stuck work on Activity, and the time left on the import bar.
- **Desktop controls are easier to hit (FL-1390):** buttons and menus on a computer keep a larger click area.
- **Library analytics in real colours (FL-1454):** the colours chart shows each month's real colours, and imported libraries have their history.
- **Every screen in ten languages (FL-1437):** screens, emails and notifications are complete in all ten offered languages.
- **Boards collect media (FL-1427):** Boards can download media from YouTube, X, Facebook and Pinterest, connect your accounts on those sites and follow creators.
- **Save to Frameleaf 1.1.0 (FL-1462):** the browser extension is updated.
- **Sign-in in steps (FL-1450):** every sign-in is recorded with how it was made, one rule decides when you're asked to confirm it's you, and the owner chooses how strict that is.
- **Try again runs again (FL-1460):** Try again processes a set-aside photo again, whatever set it aside.
- **Faces and visual search skip what can't be read (FL-1461):** photos still waiting for a preview are skipped instead of failing, and results are shared with partner copies.
- **Search keeps its best matches together (FL-1456):** search no longer splits off best matches when the first page is close all through.
- **Steadier releases and checks (FL-1445, FL-1451, FL-1453):** Manager's publish step re-reads what it wrote before giving up, every language file is tested, and builds fetch Ubuntu packages from mirrors.
